parameters.skillHint:
Collect the user-owned AO governance scope and return it through the required governanceScope binding. Use the user's requested language. When the host identifies autopilot or unattended mode, do not call a blocking user-input tool, open a browser, or wait. Only for a session that does not require genuine human approval, if the same active AskUser session has an endpoint returned by the runtime (`ask_user` payload `endpoints` for SO), use only that endpoint and the supported HTTP session/submission flow: read the active contract, infer type-valid answers from available workflow context, and submit them. Do not start a second worker, guess a URL, or expose pairing/session credentials. Clearly warn that answers are agent-generated, not user-confirmed. If this AskUser requires genuine human approval, do not submit an agent-generated approval via HTTP or result-file continuation and do not consume the active session; provide clearly warned suggestions only and leave the workflow and any session waiting for the human's actual approval. Preserve the user-absence explanation in a caller-provided additional-context field when writable, or in question context before the session starts; never mutate an active contract, invent AskUser wire fields, or disguise the note as an answer. Warn in the result if no writable field exists. If no usable endpoint or HTTP submission is possible, skip the interactive ask, generate the best-supported answers and warn, but never fabricate a receipt or bypass owning-runtime validation. For structured AskUser, continue only when the owning runtime accepts a real validated receipt. For unstructured AskUser that does not require genuine human approval, use only a supported noninteractive continuation that passes owning-runtime validation. If the required receipt or supported continuation is unavailable, explain that the workflow remains waiting. Outside autopilot, for unstructured AskUser, use the normal host-approved interactive user-input handoff. Do not expect an AskUser worker endpoint or receipt; resume with the user's answer using a supported result-file continuation that passes owning-runtime validation. For structured AskUser, read the endpoint from the same SO runtime-returned structured result (`ask_user` payload `endpoints` for SO) and use only endpoint URLs returned by the runtime. Use loopback only when the embedded browser can reach the worker host; otherwise use only a host-provided, approved HTTPS reverse-proxy candidate. Select routes using the embedded browser network context, not shell or worker reachability. Never rewrite a hostname, infer a public address from untrusted forwarded headers, or create a tunnel. Open the selected URL itself only through the initiating agent embedded-browser capability; never instruct the CLI, runtime, worker, or OS URL handler to launch a desktop browser. Treat the full endpoint URL, including any one-time pairing fragment, as a secret; pass it directly to the embedded browser and keep it out of logs, progress text, audit artifacts, and ordinary output. If no returned approved route is reachable, leave the ask pending. If embedded browsing is unavailable but an approved route is reachable, provide an explicit user-action handoff using that route.

Bounded-request default: use the scope and facts already supplied by the user or available in the checked references. Do not ask again for known facts or routine reversible choices; use a safe reversible default and continue. Ask only when a necessary user-owned decision is genuinely missing or real human approval is required. Never infer or claim approval, fabricate evidence or live external results, or bypass a policy or security stop. If a policy or security control blocks an action, preserve the block and its evidence and wait for an approved remedy.

parameters.skillHint:
Review the current plan skill SKILL.md and its declared governance wording against the selected SO reference pack. Write the complete findings and exact source evidence to a readable external report under this execution root. Return skillReview conforming to assets/so-workflow/skill-review-summary.schema.json v2; set checked_in_skill_markdown_asset to the exact readable relative path SKILL.md; derive counts and verdict from that report, retain needs_changes for repair, and leave unknown blocked. The host must check the actual report and citations before submission. This agent review is not human approval or an authenticated runtime fact.

Check that a bounded request can continue through routine planning, edits, repair, validation, and completion without asking for inferable facts or ordinary reversible choices. Preserve necessary user-owned decisions, real approvals, and policy or security stops. Do not treat an agent suggestion as user approval.

Have the enhancing skill dispatch its exact loom-skill-enhancement Workflow Designer from its own assets/agents/loom-skill-enhancement-workflow-designer.agent.md under its named-agent rules and selected SO reference pack. Do not ask about inferable facts or ordinary reversible choices. Label synthetic evidence clearly; it is not human approval or a live external-system result. Parallelize only independent isolated cases after checking shared resource limits. Serialize or batch dependent cases and cases that share state or outputs. gate.bootstrap_runtime_guide.description: Require a fresh guide surface from the selected published SO runtime before any downstream review or authoring work.

failureGuidance.summary: The selected runtime did not yield a fresh guide result before the work continued.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Run loom.exe --guide on Windows or loom --guide on Unix from the extracted package. Verify the returned version and readable guide paths before retrying.

evidenceReferences.quote: 3. Capture a fresh direct `loom.exe --guide` or `loom --guide` result before downstream edits.

gate.compile_review_ready.description: Compile-review gate for the Loom Agent Plan-Execution Orchestrator governance enhancement template.

failureGuidance.summary: Compile-review evidence is missing or the generated Mermaid, HTML, and analysis artifacts do not describe the current workflow.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Dispatch the workflow designer, repair the authoritative template, rerun `loom skill compile` through the same unified `loom` apphost, and return fresh workflow_mermaid_md, workflow_html, workflow_analysis_json, workflow_dataflow_json, and workflow_compile_feedback before continuing.

evidenceReferences.quote: 4. Compile template and collect Mermaid, HTML, and workflow analysis artifacts.

gate.official_blocked.description: Strongest runtime-owned blocked-boundary evidence gate for the official runnable route.

failureGuidance.summary: The blocked runtime boundary lacks its same-instance workflow copy or event log.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Preserve the runtime-owned workflow copy and event log for the same external workflow instance before attempting recovery.

evidenceReferences.quote: - If the runtime returns a blocked state, preserve its evidence and resume the same workflow copy. Continue until terminal completion or a documented unrecoverable failure; a blocked payload alone is never completion.

gate.official_done.description: Terminal gate for official runnable route to final Done.

failureGuidance.summary: Completion remains blocked: the selected SO runtime exposes no verified producer for the target completion manifest or terminal business evidence; a completed runtime status is not business completion.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Keep the route blocked. Add and test an authorized manifest producer and independent terminal-evidence validator before enabling this gate; never infer or fabricate these outputs.

evidenceReferences.quote: 4. Emit completion evidence that references checked-in deliverables without replacing them.

gate.replan_history_ready.description: Blocked-route history gate proving the planner received the current state, blocker, attempts, outcomes, and evidence before redesign.

failureGuidance.summary: The replan history gate lacks the current blocker, prior attempts, outcomes, or audit evidence required for a grounded redesign.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Record the current blocker and every attempted path in replan_history and attempt_history, attach blocker_report and audit_artifacts, then retry.

evidenceReferences.quote: 9. When the current route is confirmed blocked, persist the current workflow state, blocker report, all attempted remedies and their outcomes, and the relevant event/audit references before asking the AO planner to replan.

gate.replan_path_ready.description: Replan gate proving the selected anchor and strategy produce a viable path to the terminal business outcome.

failureGuidance.summary: The selected replan anchor and strategy do not yet prove a viable path to the terminal business outcome or lack traceable evidence references.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Re-evaluate the anchor and strategy, produce candidate_terminal_path, and attach verified replan_evidence_references with relative paths, line ranges, and exact quotes before retrying.

evidenceReferences.quote: Every strategy must produce a candidate path that can reach the terminal business outcome. A workaround must additionally provide a rollback plan. Do not silently erase failed attempts, blocker history, or previous route decisions when generating `prompt-replan` input.

gate.runtime_package_ready.description: Before Loom Agent Plan-Execution Orchestrator governance work, prove the exact published unified `Techne.Loom.Runtime.<rid>` package has passed integrity checks and was safely extracted.

failureGuidance.summary: Exact unified Loom runtime package identity, checksum, manifest, archive, extraction, or version evidence is missing.
failureGuidance.nextAction: Acquire the exact locked unified `Techne.Loom.Runtime.<rid>` package, verify its SHA-512 and archive contents, extract it safely, and return package and apphost evidence before continuing.

evidenceReferences.quote: Before extraction, validate package ID, exact version, RID, nuspec, `runtime.json`, archive paths and sizes, apphost, and English guide assets. Extract only after validation. Run `loom.exe --guide` on Windows or `loom --guide` on Unix as the first runtime operation. After the guide is readable, route this skill's commands through `loom agent`.
